title: Playing a house-party number at the piano
summary: Richards plays a number as he did and as he does now, and an ending Joe taught him.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom

blocks.x: Did you have any special numbers at the house parties that you used to play? If I could play that, bye bye put it in me. That was a hard number. That's alright.
